note: Curated, committed record of what each profile has actually achieved. Generated reports live in results/; this file is the durable statement and is edited deliberately, not by a script.

p1_legacy.reason: non-positive reflectance estimates in 10/152 bins at the frozen transport budget

step_A.description: recompute P1's published scale=1.0 quantities from its frozen Jacobian cache, no transport
quantities_checked: phi-space StO2 direction construction vs P1's stored e_sto2U/e_sto2D

step_B.description: rerun the nominal scale=1.0 point only and emit standardized J_phi and R

empty_bins.interpretation: These are Monte Carlo sampling shortfalls, not physically zero reflectance. P1's 30000 transport photons suffice to estimate the Jacobian but not to stabilize R across all 152 retained bins. P1's raw unweighted SVD never exposed this because it never needed R.

explicitly_rejected_remedies.why_rejected: the result would no longer be the frozen p1_legacy baseline
changes the observation space, so the spectrum is no longer comparable to the frozen one

explicitly_rejected_remedies.remedy: add an epsilon floor to R
explicitly_rejected_remedies.why_rejected: manufactures Fisher information that the simulation did not produce

p1_legacy.scope: p1_legacy is complete. Its only task was to reproduce the raw-J SVD, and that is done. It is not a whitening input.

p2_legacy.reason: all 120 bins have strictly positive pooled reflectance at 32 streams x 200000 photons
findings: P2 ships two pipelines over the same pool that disagree on three points: the photon budget (N_TOT=4e5 total in build_fim_stack.py vs PROD_N=1e5 per wavelength in fim_analyze.py), the min-count filter, and the parameter order.

The published bounds come from fim_boundary_poisson_pooled.py, which applies NO min-count filter. Enabling MIN_COUNT=5 drops 54 of 120 bins and moves the deep bound from 1.9128 to 2.4225, a 26.6% change. The spec's p2_legacy profile was corrected accordingly.
Gcw is stored in production order [StO2_U, B_U, StO2_D, B_D, DermR, SubQ]; fim_stack.npz applies PERM=[0,2,1,3,4,5] to a different order. Any consumer must declare which it uses.
The least-informed normalized eigenvector is the deep StO2 direction (StO2_D = +0.99), confirming P2's central identifiability claim.
In contrast with p1_legacy, zero of 120 bins are empty, so p2_legacy is whitening eligible.

production.status: formal 32-seed pool complete; production spectrum and CRLB frozen

pilot.purpose: validate runtime, memory, 4000-step convergence and output format before committing a full pool
pilot.why_excluded: the formal pool must use one hardware, one JAX backend and one environment; mixing one local CPU seed with 31 cluster seeds would confound the pool
findings: max_steps=4000 is fully converged: in-flight weight at termination is 0.0000 at all four wavelengths, so no photon is truncated by the step cap.
J_psi and R are finite throughout; cond(J_psi) = 1.14e5.

One non-positive bin remains at 540 nm, r = 1.475 cm, in a SINGLE seed. Pooling 32 seeds is expected to clear it, since P2's 32 x 200000 pool had zero empty bins on the same grid, but that must be confirmed on the actual pooled R, not assumed.
Compile is 1.3 s, not a meaningful share of the 59 min execution. The compile-once worker is still the right architecture, but it does not change the time budget.

production.diagnostic_policy: The energy-accounting termination diagnostic costs ~190 s per seed and is evidence about the step cap, not about the seed. It is opt-in (--diagnostic): run it on the verification seed and a spot check, not all 32 times.
production.note: The formal raw-vs-whitened comparison uses one J, one observation grid and one parameter coordinate system, switching only the likelihood.

crlb.quantity: lower bound on the standard deviation of a locally unbiased estimator at the nominal point

manuscript_contract.p1_legacy_crlb_reason: p1_legacy has no likelihood model and is retained only for raw-J SVD reproduction
